description: Create a typed secret group for a project: one named credential, such as a login or a payment card, whose fields are stored as member secrets and offered to test runs together. Pass `fields` as a map of field name to value; call muggle-remote-secret-type-list first for each secretType's fields, which are required, and their formats. Member secret names are the groupName slug plus the field ('Visa test' gives visa_test_card_number); a name that collides with an existing secret or group is rejected. Secret values are never returned.

fields.description: Field name → value for the chosen secretType; include every required field muggle-remote-secret-type-list lists for that type

groupName.description: Group name, e.g. 'Visa test card'; the member secret names are derived from it

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) to create the secret group for

secretType.description: Kind of secret group; decides which fields apply

name: muggle-remote-secret-group-create
